title: Emulator does not respond — host memory is full
symptom: adb install · shell time out, followed by ui_dump_failed (count 0) or offline
cause: Host swap is nearly full, or the AVD has 1 core/2 GB, so the watchdog keeps restarting system_server
fix: Check memory pressure with launch_cli.py doctor --resources
Clean up and boot again with launch_cli.py device reboot --device <id> --cold
If the AVD is small: emulator -avd <name> -no-snapshot -cores 4 -memory 4096
'Broken pipe'/'Can't find service: package' right after boot: wait until service check package says found, then retry
With -no-snapshot-save, app data written while running is lost on shutdown
